headline: Gutter Works Turn Warden as Weathered Expanse Battle Endures
war_summary: The Gutter has changed hands in the last watch: after a day of close work its seven works now stand six Warden and one unclaimed, with ten actions logged in the past two hours and the firing continuing up to the hour of this dispatch. The Weathered Expanse remains the war's heaviest battleground, seven actions in two hours and roughly 7,995 Colonial and 7,868 Warden losses over the day; its nine works are now three Warden, two Colonial and four unclaimed, both sides having yielded ground to ruin. Palantine Berm keeps a steady fire, three actions in two hours, its seven works six Colonial and one Warden. Marban Hollow has quieted after seven actions in six hours, its eight works five Colonial, one Warden and two unclaimed. The Nevish Line, with nineteen actions in the day, has not fired in two hours, though its casualties run 75 Colonial and 85 Warden an hour, both climbing. Godcrofts and Linn Mercy have fallen silent since yesterday afternoon and early morning respectively. Callahans Passage records no ownership changes but the war's heaviest hourly losses, near 368 Colonial and 398 Warden, both accelerating. The victory mark stands at thirty-four towns.
